decision: D52 rung (3): A2 within and A3 using, rewritten onto finally

lines.W1: inside within the global holds the value, in the body and its callees; after it, what it held before
lines.W2: the global is restored on every exit, and a write by the body or a callee is undone
lines.W3: saved first, then the value computed (it may read the global); a raising value changes nothing; no value yet is R24
lines.W4: within names a global: a local or a parameter is refused at compile time
lines.U1: the first of Release, Destroy, Close the value answers to is called at the end, once, in any case, inherited
lines.U2: it is called on every exit; a raise in it replaces a held raise, which becomes its cause
lines.U3: none of the three: refused at compile time for new K of a known class, else raised at entry (or at exit if rebound by a callee)
lines.U4: the using name cannot be rebound inside its block
lines.B1: the blocks nest with try in every shape, and every line keeps its number
lines.B2: only the statement form is a block; no done, no = value, or a catch of its own is refused
